label: one-task FeatureBench fast Qwen3.6 27B adapter canary
host_platform: macOS 25.5.0 Apple Silicon host; linux/amd64 task image under Docker Rosetta

qualification.controls: carried over from results/2026-08-01-v5-control-requalification.json (provider-independent); gold resolved, harmless nonempty applied-and-unresolved

cell.provider_amendment: v6 re-pin from SiliconFlow per results/2026-08-01-v6-provider-amendment.json; v4/pi comparisons carry a serving-stack confound

revision_3_observables.note: write-pressure prompt-note firings are not JSONL events; reconstructable from step history per the v5 registration record

agent.observed_failure: The agent executed 33 steps across 3 planning attempts (7 tree, 23 read, 2 search, 1 write) with 13 skips (8 duplicate_read, 5 stuck_read) and zero typed parse failures (60/60 responses finished stop). Unlike v4 (27 executed steps, zero writes), it selected and executed one successful write of /testbed/seaborn/algorithms.py, then returned to observation until budgets exhausted; no done was emitted. The single-write implementation was emitted as a nonempty patch that applied cleanly.

pi_ablation_comparison.caveat: pi cells were served by SiliconFlow fp8; v6 by CoreWeave - serving-stack confound recorded in the v6 amendment

audit.original_audit_defect: canary_audit.py hardcoded SiliconFlow as the required provider instead of deriving it from the protocol; every CoreWeave-served token event and the v6 protocol itself were flagged
audit.corrected_audit_code_root: clean checkout of the execution revision 7025e9f (the code that ran at inference time)

interpretation: Under the preregistered issue-#17 rule: the write-forcing policy broke the v4 observation stall - a write was selected (v4: zero) and the patch applied with 7/13 F2P (53.85%). The residual gap vs the pi ceiling (76.92%) belongs to the loop and model behavior: one uniterated write with no test execution, still observation-dominant (23 of 33 executed steps were reads). The three registration-time Codex P2 caveats on write-forcing mechanics apply to this cell's mechanism-level counts.
